featured_reviews.name: Anna Sharafulina
featured_reviews.review_text:
First, they’ll bombard you with enrollment messages for weeks.

Then, they’ll give you the class timing a week in advance.

After that, they’ll confirm the location the evening before the class.

Then they’ll conveniently forget to inform you that the class has been rescheduled.

You’ll arrive on time, only to find a locked door, after planning your entire day around the class.

I can understand human factor of the receptionist. But then why play a show, like you are calling a teacher to know where he/she is and then say “actually you know what happened, the class was rescheduled” like I supposed to know about it. And I actually supposed to. From you. In advance.

The worst thing a school can do is relentlessly chase prospective students for enrollment and payment, only to completely disregard their time, effort, and money once they’ve signed up.

I rearranged my schedule, canceled other commitments, paid for transportation, and showed up at the exact time I was instructed to be there. Only after I arrived and multiple calls from my side was I told that the class timing had changed and that nobody had informed me.

Mistakes happen, but basic communication and respect for students’ time should be the minimum standard for any educational institution. Unfortunately, that was not my experience.
P.s. the school situated in a slum looking area in a quite dirty building, so vibe is not vibing. Can’t say anything about the teachers though, maybe they are nice.
Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Jennifer Carneiro
featured_reviews.review_text: It's six months now since I enrolled for this class and I must say that the faculty is very dedicated. I initially felt that with me not having any background for music it will be very difficult and I was thinking how long I could carry on. Thanks to the teaching methods and the personalized attention, I have developed a better sense of music. Introduction to the theory by Animesh Sir is very simple and effortless to remember. He even jots down the notes in a simplified manner.   Sahil Sir had taught to hear the tones rather than go for rote learning. Rushabh Sir also guides when in doubt. In short , the emphasis is on understanding rather than just memorizing the notes. The team led by Shravan Sir are themselves fully trained and enjoy their skill while making it a enjoyable session for the learners. At Keynote, if you miss the classes, they call to pursue you so that you attend without any excuses. It's for all age groups , kids, working professionals and home makers too. For the kids too, they have a friendly approach where they let them enjoy while they learn.They guide you on the music instruments and suggest reasonable ones too.  I had a guitar for which the strings had rusted, Shravan Sir got this replaced thus saving me the extra cost of buying the entire guitar. A must for music lovers and learners. You have to enrol to experience. Wishing Shravan Sir, Animesh Sir, Rushabh Sir and Sahil Sir all the very best .
